kind: ADDITIVE, IMMUTABLE, AUTHORITATIVE FOR EVERY SUBSEQUENT STAGE
authorised_by: THE USER, explicitly. The architect is gate owner and reviewer, not approver.

scope.applies_to: every V26C stage evaluated from this date onward, and any successor pipeline that adopts this contract
scope.does_not_apply_to: runs already executed and recorded. Their receipts were produced under the contract in force at the time and remain valid evidence of that contract.
scope.supersedes_clause: the penetration acceptance clause of the earlier amendments, WITHOUT editing them. Those files keep their own text and their own hashes; this contract stands beside them and governs future evaluation.

soft_diagnostic.meaning: reported on every stage as a shaping/attention signal. It never fails a run and never blocks a stage.

july_legacy_hard_reference.role: JULY LEGACY HARD REFERENCE - COMPARATIVE DIAGNOSTIC ONLY
july_legacy_hard_reference.historical_semantics: July's own gate passed iff max < 0.025 (strict). teacher_summary.json records gate.penetration_below_hard_guard for the 2026-07-11_v2 teacher.
july_legacy_hard_reference.at_exactly_0.025: BREACH under the diagnostic convention (>= 0.025), because July's pass was strict (< 0.025)
july_legacy_hard_reference.meaning: reported so any result can be compared with the July operating point. It carries no acceptance power today.

hard_binding.meaning: the single penetration criterion that can fail or stop a run. It matches the runtime termination boundary exactly.

counting_conventions.rationale: the soft and hard counts use strict inequalities, matching the existing steps_above_soft code and the runtime termination test. The July legacy count uses >= because July's pass was strict (< 0.025), so its complement is >=.

runtime_unchanged.statement: the RUNTIME is not touched by this contract. Reward shaping and termination keep their pinned values.
runtime_unchanged.runtime_termination_test: osim_trj_cmc_like.py terminates when applied penetration > grf_penetration_termination_m, so the gate's inclusive <= 0.028 and the runtime agree exactly at the boundary

does_not_do.does_not_rewrite_historical_verdicts: the J1 FAIL, the J3 FAIL, the J4 technical/offline PASS and the J5-r2 FAIL all STAND exactly as recorded. This contract never edits a receipt, a trace or a run leaf.
does_not_do.reconciliation_is_informational: any re-evaluation of a past run under this contract is a separate, clearly labelled reconciliation record. It never replaces the original verdict.

immutability: this file is content-addressed by the artefacts it pins. Any change to a pinned artefact invalidates it. It is never edited in place.
